text.tspan: Every number is computed over the tasks that run has finished, counted under each heading.
Nothing is extrapolated, so the columns are not comparable: a mean over 3 tasks is not a mean over 5.
· not reached yet. — last task of that run, no backward transfer by construction.
Only CLEAR is complete, and it predates the threshold fix, so it trained each task to a lower bar.
* Forward transfer unresolved. Not measurable from these runs (per-task heads, untrained until
that task arrives), and the from-scratch baseline the AUC form needs is being recomputed.
Treat every forward-transfer number in this project as provisional.
